tools.name: next_injection_site
tools.description: Suggest the least recently used of the six common subcutaneous injection sites from a history of sites (most recent last). Rotation helper only: it never recommends or calculates doses.

tools.name: shot_day_countdown
tools.description: Days until the next weekly shot day (0 = today) for a weekday and a reference date. A countdown only.

tools.name: glp1_search_interest
tools.description: Average monthly Google searches for Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound, Saxenda, tirzepatide and semaglutide in a country (ISO code, e.g. US, BR, JP), from Bluedose's open dataset (Google Keyword Planner, Nov 2026). Searches show interest, not prescriptions.
